name: Central Plastics
old_description: Central Plastics is the go-to custom molder for all your plastic component needs. Our one-stop manufacturing facility located in the heart of California specializes in injection molding and thermoforming packaging, meaning our customers know they’re getting the best manufacturing process for their project.
about:
Central Plastics operates from Tracy, California, as a minority- and woman-owned contract development and manufacturing organization. The company does not disclose its founding year or founders publicly.

The firm provides custom plastic injection molding, injection stretch blow molding (ISBM), and custom thermoforming, supported by in-house tooling and engineering. Its facility runs on sustainable energy and houses equipment for scientific molding, prototyping, pilot lots, and commercial-scale continuous production. Value-added services include hot stamping, heat insertion, sonic welding, and assembly.

Central Plastics serves healthcare, aerospace, packaging, defense, consumer, toy and education, and electronics markets. The company emphasizes end-to-end traceability, a metrology lab for first-article inspection, and PPAP levels 1 through 5.

The company differentiates itself through its ISO 13485:2016 and AS9100 Rev D certifications, a cloud-based QMS, and a commitment to diversity and inclusion. It positions itself as an all-in-one provider covering design through production.
